T90-T2-20261009. Implementation complete for the WSL host; commit 02ba09ad1 (two test files). Closing handover at the 80 % checkpoint: NATIVE capture is still outstanding. independent review: pending (G-adjacent; the delta Critic is the Elephant's). Not PO-accepted.

Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh, observed claude-sonnet-5-5 (runtime prompt); effort not observable; no contradiction.

1. DoD results
- (i) re-pin (a),(a2),(b),(c),(d1),(d2) through dependencies.auditLockHost: passed on WSL (all six green on Linux with an injected win32 host; names unchanged). Native win32: not verifiable (see 6).
- (ii) tolerance boundary: passed on WSL (+/-1 minute ambiguous, +/-2 dead).
- (iii) malformed seam -> HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-MALFORMED: passed on WSL (11 malformed shapes, no lock published).
- (iv) stale skip reason and SEAM: none header removed and replaced with the true state: done. One skip remains (see 5).
- extra: T90-T2 (seam) owner-recording pin: passed on WSL.
- (v) renderer pins: 3 RED for the stated reason only (output has 2 lines, expected 3): well-formed (every platform), host default, and hostile-command-rebuilt. Green today as briefed: malformed recovery -> exactly today's two lines (26 shapes x 3 platforms), recovery on another code, hostile command never echoed.
- (vi) CLI pin: RED for the stated reason only (stderr is exactly 'HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-AMBIGUOUS: audit lock owner state is ambiguous\n', no recovery line). Seam: main(argv, io, { dependencies }) for repair-audit; dependencies spread into acquireAuditLock; afterTemporarySyncFn throws the hand-built error. Stop condition 2 did not fire.
- WSL totals (both files): 195 tests, 190 pass, 4 fail, 1 skipped, wrapped exit 1. Red cases: (1) T90-T2 (v): a well-formed audit-lock recovery renders ONE extra line naming the lock, an attended delete and its precondition; (2) T90-T2 (v): the host default (no platform argument) renders the same one-line recovery; (3) T90-T2 (v): a hostile recovery.command changes nothing: the line is rebuilt from the validated files; (4) repair-audit prints the typed audit-lock recovery on stderr, from the same helper as the shared renderer (T90-T2 RED pin). Every pre-existing case passes; the six pins that were skipped on WSL in the baseline now run and pass.
- check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, exit 0, 9/9.
- Commit with exactly the two paths and the two trailers: passed (first attempt hit .git/index.lock, one identical retry after a non-git step succeeded).
- Native capture of both files: NOT VERIFIED (see 6).

2. Evidence
- evidence/T90-T2-20261009/wsl.txt: wsl.exe -e bash -lc "cd <repo-root-in-wsl>; node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-T2-20261009/wsl.txt --label wsl -- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.test.mjs", Bash timeout 600000, wrapped exit code 1 (the 4 RED pins). The 'cd ...;' form was admitted by the guard.
- evidence/T90-T2-20261009/native.txt: command node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-T2-20261009/native.txt --label native -- node --test <the two files>; exceeded the 600 s Bash timeout and was moved to the background (task brcs953e7); the file did not exist at call 48 and a later read of it was refused by the guard (no retry around it).
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: exit 0 (console, 9 tests).

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs (02ba09ad1): T90-T header/skip text rewritten; helpers plantLock/attempt/expectReclaimed/expectAmbiguous gain an optional dependencies parameter (existing call sites untouched); (a)-(d2) converted to the seam; new (ii), (iii), (seam), (real host); renderer RED pins block after the 'bounded to typed tokens' test.
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.test.mjs (02ba09ad1): imports HumanGuardOverrideError and humanGuardRouteUnavailableReason; one RED CLI pin for repair-audit.

4. Deliberately not changed
- Every production file (human-guard-override.mjs, guard-human-override.mjs); po-human-approval.mjs (foreign uncommitted edit); the foreign staged and untracked files.
- Test (f) exact-keys pin, tests (e) and (L), deadPid(), sandbox(): untouched.
- The live HGO store and its lock files: all lock fixtures live in temp repositories.

5. Deviations from spec
- One skip remains: 'T90-T2 (real host)' (native win32 only, typed reason). The briefing expected only (L). Reason: the converted pins no longer exercise the real process.kill probe or the real uptime-derived boot minute, and a vacuous pass on other hosts would be worse than a typed skip. On WSL the skip count is 1 (the real-host variant), on native win32 it should be 1 (L).
- Renderer platform: the renderer cannot see a lock fixture's platform, so the pins inject it as a THIRD ARGUMENT { platform } (assumption R2, named in the case header) and also run a host-default case.
- CLI error is hand-built with the repository-relative lock path and injected via afterTemporarySyncFn, not produced by a planted lock (assumption C3).
- Assumptions named in the headers (R1-R6, C1-C3): third-line placement; substrings (precondition verbatim lower-case, 'attended' case-insensitive, 'may still be live' on win32, `rm -- '<file>'` / `Remove-Item -LiteralPath '<file>'`); entry validity form; the shared helper's line equals the CLI's.
- The (ii) boundary pins the T90-F reading (MORE THAN 1 minute apart is dead); a Critic ruling for the literal Ruling 111 changes that pin.
- I read neither the CONT15 header nor any other briefing file; the WSL form came from the briefing text.

6. Open items
- NATIVE VERIFY OUTSTANDING: evidence/T90-T2-20261009/native.txt (background task brcs953e7 may still complete and write it). Expected: the same 4 RED cases, all else green, the real-host variant running, (L) skipped. If absent, rerun natively, ideally with --test-name-pattern=T90-T2 plus the T90-T names, or split the files.
- PRODUCTION GAP (for T90-F2): ambiguousAuditLockRefusal emits the ABSOLUTE lock path (paths.auditLock), but Ruling 125's renderer accepts only repository-relative paths under .git/agent-pipeline/human-guard-overrides/. A literal reuse of today's error renders NO recovery line. The fix slice must emit or derive the relative form (assumption R6).
- independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending.
- Uncommitted artifacts: evidence/T90-T2-20261009/wsl.txt, this record, scratch/commit-msg/T90-T2.txt; evidence/T90-T2-20261009/native.txt when it lands.
- Closing handover: Committed: 02ba09ad1 (the two test files). Verified green: WSL totals above, consumer-safe exit 0. Remains undone: native capture. Next briefing: split native into a name-pattern run or grant a longer window; state the platform-injection and relative-path assumptions as decided.
